cohort: The study included women with class I obesity who delivered in a tertiary university-affiliated hospital, comparing those who delivered during specific three months of the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic with those who delivered during the same three months of the previous year.
finding: Women with class I obesity had higher gestational weight gain during the COVID-19 pandemic, but surprisingly showed lower rates of gestational diabetes and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy compared to the previous year.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from three months of the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic and three months of the previous year.
